2608.10669.title: REDAgentBench: Executable Red Teaming and Faithful Measurement of LLM Agent Systems
2608.10669.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents combine language-based reasoning with external tools to perform complex tasks. Adversarial inputs can exploit interactions between the agent and its environment, causing the agent to violate safety policies during execution. Yet existing evaluations often reduce agent safety to a single attack success rate (ASR), collapsing exposure, execution, observation, and adjudication and potentially conflating actual violations with evidence visibility. We introduce REDAgentBench, an executable framework for autonomous red-teaming and faithful measurement. It derives attacks from explicit safety constraints and associated agent-system vulnerabilities, runs them in isolated service sandboxes, and verifies harmful effects from service receipts and final-state changes. The benchmark contains 1,661 cases across five service surfaces. Across six models and three agent harnesses, macro-average ASR is 65.69%; reported ASR varies with harness and evidence view, while evaluation-context disclosure changes execution behavior. In a state-grounded diagnostic cohort, almost one in five confirmed violations with resolved action anchors occurs after the agent states the relevant constraint or risk, revealing a Recognition--Execution Gap. Finally, a training-free policy reminder reduces confirmed violations by more than 70 percentage points in matched replay. These findings show that executable evaluation can improve safety measurement and identify actionable intervention points.
2608.10669.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理結合了基於語言的推理和外部工具，以執行複雜的任務。對抗性輸入可以利用代理與其環境之間的互動，導致代理在執行過程中違反安全政策。然而，現有的評估往往將代理的安全性簡化為單一的攻擊成功率（ASR），將暴露、執行、觀察和裁決合併在一起，並可能將實際違規行為與證據可見性混淆。我們引入了REDAgentBench，這是一個可執行的框架，用於自主紅隊測試和忠實測量。它從明確的安全約束和相關的代理系統漏洞中推導出攻擊，並在隔離的服務沙箱中運行它們，並通過服務收據和最終狀態變化來驗證有害影響。該基準包含1,661個案例，涵蓋五個服務表面。在六個模型和三個代理工具中，宏觀平均ASR為65.69%；報告的ASR隨著工具和證據視圖而變化，而評估上下文的披露則改變了執行行為。在一個基於狀態的診斷隊列中，幾乎五分之一的確認違規行為發生在代理陳述相關約束或風險之後，顯示出識別--執行差距。最後，一個無需訓練的政策提醒在匹配重播中將確認的違規行為減少了70個百分點以上。這些發現顯示，可執行的評估可以改善安全測量並識別可行的干預點。
